title: Vision Prescription Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Open Dental appointments (`opendental:appointment`), Zocdoc bookings (`zocdoc:booking`), vision prescriptions (`vision:prescription`), dental hygiene visits (`dental:hygiene`), and Withings eye-health checks (`withings:eye`).
app: Open Dental appointment exports, Zocdoc booking webhooks, vision prescription sidecars, dental hygiene visit logs, and Withings Vision eye-health readings streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vision:prescription
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(optometrist) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many vision prescription events land each day and how many distinct optometrist values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest vision prescription records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct optometrist values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how much vision prescription activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
